contents.description: The base64-encoded contents of the certificate to import. May be a PFX or a PEM bundle.

password.description: The password protecting the certificate contents, if any.

keyType.description: The type of key. One of 'RSA', 'RSA-HSM', 'EC', 'EC-HSM' or 'oct'.

keySize.description: The size of the key. Required for RSA keys, e.g. 2048, 3072 or 4096.

reuseKey.description: Whether to reuse the key when the certificate is renewed.

curve.description: The curve type for elliptic curve keys. One of 'P-256', 'P-256K', 'P-384' or 'P-521'.

contentType.description: The content type of the secret backing the certificate. Either 'application/x-pkcs12' or 'application/x-pem-file'.

upns.description: User principal names in the certificate.

subject.description: The subject name of the certificate, e.g. 'CN=contoso.com'.

ekus.description: Enhanced key usage extensions, as OIDs, e.g. '1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1'.

lifetimePercentage.description: Percentage of the certificate lifetime at which to trigger the action. Must be between 1 and 99, and cannot be combined with 'daysBeforeExpiry'.

daysBeforeExpiry.description: Days before expiry at which to trigger the action. Cannot be combined with 'lifetimePercentage'.

actionType.description: The type of action to perform. Either 'AutoRenew' or 'EmailContacts'.

trigger.description: The trigger for the lifetime action.

name.description: The name of the issuer. Use 'Self' for a self-signed certificate, 'Unknown' for a certificate signed by an external CA, or the name of a 'CertificateIssuer' resource.

certificateType.description: The type of certificate to request from the issuer.

created.description: The UTC date/time at which the certificate was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated.description: The UTC date/time at which the certificate was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

expires.description: The UTC date/time at which the certificate expires, in ISO 8601 format.

notBefore.description: The UTC date/time before which the certificate cannot be used, in ISO 8601 format.

recoveryLevel.description: The deletion recovery level currently in effect for the certificate.

import.description: An existing certificate to import. Mutually exclusive with the policy properties ('key', 'secret', 'x509Properties', 'issuer', 'lifetimeActions').

tags.description: Tags to apply to the certificate.

id.description: The versioned URI of the certificate.

versionlessId.description: The URI of the certificate, without a version. Use this to always resolve the latest version.

secretId.description: The versioned URI of the KeyVault secret backing the certificate.

versionlessSecretId.description: The URI of the KeyVault secret backing the certificate, without a version.

keyId.description: The versioned URI of the KeyVault key backing the certificate.

certificateData.description: The raw DER-encoded certificate, as a lower-case hexadecimal string.

certificateDataBase64.description: The raw DER-encoded certificate, as a base64-encoded string.

thumbprint.description: The X.509 SHA-1 thumbprint of the certificate, as an upper-case hexadecimal string.

certificateAttributes.description: Read-only attributes of the certificate as reported by KeyVault.

vaultUri.description: The URI of the Key Vault holding the certificate. Defaults to the 'vaultUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

name.description: The name of the certificate in KeyVault.

email.description: The email address of the contact.

phone.description: The phone number of the contact.

contacts.description: The contacts notified by certificate lifetime actions. This replaces the full set of contacts configured on the vault.

vaultUri.description: The URI of the Key Vault holding the contacts. Defaults to the 'vaultUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the administrator.

firstName.description: The first name of the administrator.

lastName.description: The last name of the administrator.

phone.description: The phone number of the administrator.

providerName.description: The name of the certificate authority provider. One of 'DigiCert', 'GlobalSign', 'OneCertV2-PrivateCA', 'OneCertV2-PublicCA' or 'SslAdminV2'.

orgId.description: The organization ID registered with the certificate authority.

accountId.description: The account ID registered with the certificate authority.

password.description: The password for the account registered with the certificate authority. This must be supplied on every deployment: the issuer is written as a whole, and KeyVault never returns the stored password.

admins.description: The administrators registered with the certificate authority.

id.description: The URI of the certificate issuer.

createdOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the issuer was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the issuer was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

vaultUri.description: The URI of the Key Vault holding the issuer. Defaults to the 'vaultUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

name.description: The name of the certificate issuer in KeyVault.

json.description: The release policy, as a JSON string.

immutable.description: Whether the release policy is immutable. An immutable policy cannot be changed once set.

timeAfterCreation.description: Rotate the key this long after it was created, as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'P90D'. Cannot be combined with 'timeBeforeExpiry'.

timeBeforeExpiry.description: Rotate the key this long before it expires, as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'P30D'. Cannot be combined with 'timeAfterCreation'.

expireAfter.description: How long a newly rotated key remains valid, as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'P90D'. Must be at least 'P28D'.

notifyBeforeExpiry.description: How long before expiry to raise a notification event, as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'P29D'.

automatic.description: Configures automatic rotation. When omitted, the key is not rotated automatically.

keyType.description: The type of key to create. One of 'RSA', 'RSA-HSM', 'EC', 'EC-HSM', 'oct' or 'oct-HSM'.

keyOps.description: The permitted JSON web key operations, e.g. 'sign', 'verify', 'encrypt', 'decrypt', 'wrapKey', 'unwrapKey'.

keySize.description: The size of the key in bits. Required for 'RSA', 'RSA-HSM', 'oct' and 'oct-HSM' keys, e.g. 2048, 3072 or 4096.

curve.description: The elliptic curve name. Required for 'EC' and 'EC-HSM' keys. One of 'P-256', 'P-256K', 'P-384' or 'P-521'.

exportable.description: Whether the private key can be exported. Requires a release policy.

notBefore.description: The UTC date/time before which the key cannot be used, in ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

expiresOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the key expires, in ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

releasePolicy.description: The policy rules under which the key can be exported.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the key.

id.description: The versioned URI of the key.

versionlessId.description: The URI of the key, without a version. Use this to always resolve the latest version.

n.description: The RSA modulus, as a base64url-encoded string.

e.description: The RSA public exponent, as a base64url-encoded string.

x.description: The elliptic curve X component, as a base64url-encoded string.

y.description: The elliptic curve Y component, as a base64url-encoded string.

publicKeyPem.description: The PEM-encoded public key. Only populated for RSA and EC keys.

publicKeyOpenSsh.description: The OpenSSH-encoded public key. Only populated for RSA and EC keys.

createdOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the key was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the key was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

recoveryLevel.description: The deletion recovery level currently in effect for the key.

vaultUri.description: The URI of the Key Vault holding the key. Defaults to the 'vaultUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

name.description: The name of the key in KeyVault.

keyType.description: The type of key to create. One of 'RSA-HSM', 'EC-HSM' or 'oct-HSM'.

keyOps.description: The permitted JSON web key operations, e.g. 'sign', 'verify', 'wrapKey', 'unwrapKey'.

keySize.description: The size of the key in bits. Required for 'RSA-HSM' and 'oct-HSM' keys.

curve.description: The elliptic curve name. Required for 'EC-HSM' keys. One of 'P-256', 'P-256K', 'P-384' or 'P-521'.

notBefore.description: The UTC date/time before which the key cannot be used, in ISO 8601 format.

expiresOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the key expires, in ISO 8601 format.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the key.

versionedId.description: The versioned URI of the key.

id.description: The URI of the key, without a version.

createdOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the key was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the key was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

recoveryLevel.description: The deletion recovery level currently in effect for the key.

managedHsmUri.description: The URI of the Managed HSM holding the key. Defaults to the 'managedHsmUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

name.description: The name of the key in the Managed HSM.

expireAfter.description: How long a newly rotated key remains valid, as an ISO 8601 duration. Must be at least 'P28D'.

timeAfterCreation.description: Rotate the key this long after it was created, as an ISO 8601 duration. Exactly one of 'timeAfterCreation' or 'timeBeforeExpiry' must be supplied.

timeBeforeExpiry.description: Rotate the key this long before it expires, as an ISO 8601 duration. Exactly one of 'timeAfterCreation' or 'timeBeforeExpiry' must be supplied.

notifyBeforeExpiry.description: How long before expiry to raise a notification event, as an ISO 8601 duration.

id.description: The URI of the key the rotation policy applies to.

managedHsmUri.description: The URI of the Managed HSM holding the key. Defaults to the 'managedHsmUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

keyName.description: The name of the Managed HSM key the rotation policy applies to.

actions.description: Control plane actions allowed by the role.

notActions.description: Control plane actions denied by the role.

dataActions.description: Data plane actions allowed by the role, e.g. 'Microsoft.KeyVault/managedHsm/keys/read/action'.

notDataActions.description: Data plane actions denied by the role.

roleName.description: The display name of the role.

permissions.description: The permissions granted by the role.

assignableScopes.description: The scopes the role can be assigned at. Defaults to the role definition's own scope.

id.description: The fully qualified ID of the role definition.

roleType.description: The type of the role. Either 'AKVBuiltInRole' or 'CustomRole'.

managedHsmUri.description: The URI of the Managed HSM. Defaults to the 'managedHsmUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

scope.description: The scope the role definition applies to, e.g. '/' or '/keys'.

name.description: The name of the role definition. Must be a GUID.

roleDefinitionId.description: The ID of the role definition to assign.

principalId.description: The object ID of the user, group or service principal to assign the role to.

id.description: The fully qualified ID of the role assignment.

managedHsmUri.description: The URI of the Managed HSM. Defaults to the 'managedHsmUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

scope.description: The scope the role assignment applies to, e.g. '/' or '/keys'.

name.description: The name of the role assignment. Must be a GUID.

value.description: The value of the secret in KeyVault. Changing this creates a new version of the secret.

contentType.description: The content type of the secret, e.g. 'text/plain'.

notBefore.description: The UTC date/time before which the secret cannot be used, in ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

expiresOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the secret expires, in ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the secret.

id.description: The versioned URI of the secret.

versionlessId.description: The URI of the secret, without a version. Use this to always resolve the latest version.

updatedOn.description: The UTC date/time at which the secret was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

recoveryLevel.description: The deletion recovery level currently in effect for the secret.

vaultUri.description: The URI of the Key Vault holding the secret. Defaults to the 'vaultUri' supplied in the extension configuration.

name.description: The name of the secret in KeyVault.

vaultUri.description: The URI of the Key Vault, e.g. 'https://myvault.vault.azure.net/'. Individual resources may override this with their own 'vaultUri' property.

purgeOnDelete.description: Permanently purge objects after deleting them, instead of leaving them in a soft-deleted state. Defaults to false.

recoverSoftDeleted.description: Recover objects that are in a soft-deleted state instead of failing to create them. Defaults to false.
